title: 3권 1유닛 장면 · 2
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble, Pim & Pam. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: Pim and Pam puff out their tiny chests and say the sound together with all their might, but only a tiny puff of air comes out and the big door just rattles. High above on a leafy branch, Grumble the old raccoon in his striped nightcap has popped his head out of his treetop bed, cross and sleepy, one paw pressed to his mouth, saying Shh! loudly down at them — a big swirling gust of wind rushes down from him, and the round door bursts open with sparkles. Bun's floppy ear and Hedgie's spikes blow back; Pip tumbles in the air. Hidden in the picture: the garden shed, a white dish on a stump, the striped fish in the stream. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers. Pim & Pam is two tiny twin bluebirds always side by side, one with a small red feather tuft and one with a small yellow feather tuft, round sky-blue bodies with white bellies, big shiny black eyes, tiny orange beaks, their inner wingtips touching, drawn together as one pair, no letters anywhere.
